<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">BiLSTM (2-layer AGNews classifier)  |  Architecture overview</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="65" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">AGNews / 2 layers / bidirectional H256 / concat512 / dropout.5 / eval  /  read bottom to top</tspan>
</text>

</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="269.0" y="615" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#c8ebfb" stroke="#263348" />

<tspan x="292.0" dy="0">Conv / MLP</tspan>
</text>

<tspan x="477.0" dy="0">Pool</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="639.0" y="615" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#fff6bd" stroke="#263348" />

<tspan x="662.0" dy="0">Norm / Add / Cat</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="824.0" y="615" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#dfdff8" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="847.0" y="628" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="847.0" dy="0">Linear / Output</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1009.0" y="615" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#f3f5f7" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="1032.0" y="628" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="1032.0" dy="0">Activation</tspan>
</text>
<rect xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="546.5" y="645" width="16" height="16" rx="3" fill="#ffddb3" stroke="#263348" />
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="569.5" y="658" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="start" fill="#172336">
<tspan x="569.5" dy="0">Recurrent</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="686" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">T: padded time axis; B: batch; V: actual vocabulary; H=256 per direction; h_n=[4,B,H]</tspan>
<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">orange: recurrent library boundary / yellow: ordered directional concat / purple: Linear</tspan>
<tspan x="629.0" dy="16.52">last layer forward and reverse run as parallel operands; they are concatenated, not added</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="760" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Reviewed static source + selected profile. Repeated groups are templates; shapes are not runtime observations.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="790" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">E### = source span; dashed = side / shape dependencies; fork/join roles are typed in IR; no implicit sum.</tspan>
</text>
<text xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" x="629.0" y="815" font-family="DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" text-anchor="middle" fill="#344155">
<tspan x="629.0" dy="0">Repeated colors encode operation roles. Shared weights and independent instances are recorded in semantic_ir.json.</tspan>
</text>
